preconditions.description: The number of nodes n and the number of inspected nodes k must satisfy the given bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 1000000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each building time a_i must be within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly n-1 edges, each connecting two distinct nodes within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(max(a[:k] for a in all_possible_traversals))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible minimum grade Jacob can achieve by choosing the optimal root and neighbor order.
